intro: Silithus is a desolate, wind-scoured desert located in the far southwestern corner of Kalimdor. Beneath its arid sands lie vast colonies of insectoid silithid and the ancient ruins of Ahn'Qiraj, sealed a millennium ago behind the formidable Scarab Wall. Today, the druids of the Cenarion Circle maintain an embattled vigil against creeping swarms, doomsday cultists.

p: Reaching Silithus requires navigating through the primeval jungle of Un'Goro Crater and ascending a wide, rocky pass nestled in its northwestern corner. The transition is stark: lush primordial growth vanishes into a vast expanse of shifting dunes, jagged stone, and unnatural towering hives. Water is virtually nonexistent, and the winds carry the hum of insect wings and the whispering sands. The Cenarion Circle maintains Cenarion Hold near the center of the desert, serving as the sole bastion of civilization and shelter for travelers, researchers, and warriors braving the hostile wastes.

A thousand years ago, this arid expanse served as the battlefield for the War of the Shifting Sands. An allied army of night elves and great dragonflights fought desperately to drive back the Qiraji, an insidious insectoid empire spawned from the ancient Aqiri civilization. When total victory proved impossible, the defenders sealed the swarms within their stronghold using the Scarab Wall and the enchanted Scarab Dais. While the monumental gates held, subterranean tunnels allowed the beast-like silithids to burrow out, establishing sprawling colonies such as Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal throughout the sands.

The apocalyptic Twilight's Hammer cult has entrenched itself across several fortified outposts, summoning elemental terrors and venerating the dark power slumbering beneath Ahn'Qiraj. Cenarion Circle observers monitor the desert's spreading silithid colonies and the ancient threat behind the Scarab Wall.
